key.name: history-size
key.description: Oldest unpinned entries are evicted first. Range 1–100.

key.name: item-bytes-max
key.description: Longer copies are truncated on a character boundary and marked truncated. Range 1024–524288.

key.name: total-bytes-max
key.summary: Maximum total stored bytes across entries
key.description: Oldest unpinned entries are evicted until under budget. Range 65536–8388608.

key.name: pinned-max
key.description: Pinning beyond this limit is refused. Range 1–30.

key.name: paused
key.description: While paused, new clipboard content is ignored. Persisted across restarts.

key.name: toggle-menu
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens or closes the clipboard history popup.
